observation: The earlier answer that the competition does not score the graph file on its own was withdrawn: the brief asks the agent to pull in contextual data from public KGs and databases, and the graph is the object under test for the 30% pruning score, the 10% standards score and the held-out link-prediction comparison. What remains unpublished is a direct structural overlap metric against Pharos; comparison is through outcomes, keep/prune verdicts and the four weights. The corrected assessment also notes the current extract is Pharos-only, the arms are compared within the slice rather than against hosted Pharos, pruning is on injected errors, and no KGX/BioLink TSV export exists.
